title: Smart reports, surveys, and pooled group budgets for Claude Enterprise
summary: Claude Enterprise adds smart reports, in-app surveys, and pooled group budgets to give admins visibility into the value and cost of Claude usage. Smart reports sample transcripts for a chosen team and date range, group work into workstreams, and show spend, deliverables, and friction points. Surveys offer customizable default questions targeted to chosen users with live, exportable responses, and pooled budgets set a shared monthly team limit with individual limits still applying, let members request more, and send admin alerts at 50, 75, 95, and 100%.

title: Manage costs and demonstrate ROI for Claude Code on Google Cloud
summary: This Google Cloud best-practices guide, drawn from a webinar, covers controlling spend and measuring ROI for Claude Code under a control, track, and prove framework. It describes a self-hosted Claude apps gateway with spend caps per user, IdP group, or org, model allowlists, warnings at 75% and 95%, and HTTP 429 responses at the cap, plus OpenTelemetry data now broken down by skill, plugin, agent, and MCP server for Cloud Monitoring and BigQuery. The guide advises guiding rather than restricting usage and treats cost per task as the key metric.

title: Expanding Claude for Nonprofits
summary: The Claude for Nonprofits plugin, built with about 30 nonprofits, is auto-installed at no extra cost for verified nonprofits on Team and Enterprise, covering team extension, setup with org context and AI policy, and fundraising support. Verified nonprofits in low- and middle-income countries get about 90% off, with Team seats at $3/user/month, Claude Code included, and a two-person Team plan minimum. Anthropic reports 25,000+ nonprofits use Claude, over 75% with fewer than 10 seats, and a Claude Corps extension with Taproot is planned.

title: Building agents: When to fold subagents into your main agent loop
summary: Claude Platform guidance says a single agent loop with skills and tools can often replace an orchestrator plus specialist subagents, with skills holding domain procedures and tools handling actions and live data. It recommends migrating step by step by building a small end-to-end eval and folding in one subagent at a time, and reportedly shows enterprise comparisons where single agents match or beat subagent designs at lower cost and latency. Subagents still fit context bloat, parallel work, and tool or instruction conflicts.

title: Unified chat and Cowork for Claude Enterprise
summary: The unified chat and Cowork experience is now generally available for Enterprise on web, desktop, and mobile, with no mode selection required. Simple questions get quick answers, while code and file tasks run in a managed cloud environment that keeps going after the laptop is closed, and existing chats, projects, connectors, skills, and plugins carry over. Security features include an isolated VM per session, network off by default, SSO, Compliance API, and role-based access, and cost controls include usage-based pricing, a new Efficient mode (Sonnet and Haiku only), per-role models, spend limits, and pooled budgets.

title: Claude Duet Safety, Privacy, and Security
summary: Claude Duet is a research-preview agent that uses a cloud computer to handle tasks like inbox management, drafts, bookings, and routines while the user is away. It adds approval controls that show the action, destination, and content before sensitive sends, payments, or deletions, always blocks some actions such as trading or moving money, and an outgoing-message classifier keeps credentials, card and bank numbers, and government IDs from being shared. Anthropic notes that safeguards will sometimes miss things and that approval frequency and sign-in methods are still being refined.
